name: computer/convert-documents
title: Convert a document
summary: Convert documents between formats (Markdown, HTML, DOCX, PDF) and open the result.
when: Use when the user wants a document in another format, such as Markdown to PDF or a Word file to text.
steps: Call list_files or glob_files to find the exact file and confirm its extension before converting anything.
Call convert_document with path and to, for example md to pdf, and leave output empty so the new file sits beside it.
Call read_file on text results, or doc_add then doc_read for PDF and Office files, to read the converted content.
Call run_command with pdfinfo new.pdf or wc -l new.txt to check the page or line count is complete.
Call convert_document again with an explicit output path when the default name would land on a file you need.
If a conversion fails, call run_command with pandoc --version or libreoffice --version to see which converter exists.
If a needed converter is missing, say so plainly, name the package and offer a format the machine does handle.
Call open_path on the new file when the user wants to see it, and report the path, format and check result.
next: The final answer must give the new file path and format, the check that it is complete, and confirm the original was not changed.
